description_en: Describes the auto-renewal status of a subscription PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 查询PolarDB包年包月集群自动续费状态
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-auto-renew-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-ids pc-0000000000000000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --resource-group-id rg-re000000000 --cloud-provider ENS --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看地域ID详情。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster. You can specify multiple cluster IDs, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID，支持传入多个集群ID，多个集群ID间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值范围为30、50、100，默认值为30。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud provider of the instance
parameters.name: cloud_provider

AutoRenewAttribute.description_en: A list of renewal information about the clusters

AutoRenewEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled.

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.

false: Auto-renewal is disabled
AutoRenewEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启自动续费： 

true：开启。 
false：关闭。

PeriodUnit.description_en:
The unit of the renewal duration.

Year

Month
PeriodUnit.description_zh:
时长单位： 

Year：年。 
Month：月

RenewalStatus.description_en:
The renewal status. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: Auto-renewal is enabled.

Normal: Manual renewal is enabled. You are notified by a text message before the cluster expires.

NotRenewal: The cluster is not renewed. No notification is sent before the cluster expires. A non-renewal reminder is sent three days before the expiration date
RenewalStatus.description_zh:
续费状态，取值范围如下： 

AutoRenewal：自动续费。  
Normal：手动续费，到期前短信提醒。 
NotRenewal：到期不续费，到期前无提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒
